resolutions.title: The Size-section parser diverges from its CommonMark line table at three edges
resolutions.action: applied the ratified direction A: the parser reads CommonMark indentation — headings at up to three spaces of indent open and end the section, a bullet indented two or three spaces is an item of the section when no item stands above it in the current list, the list ends at a heading or an unindented paragraph after a blank line, and a thematic break is not read; the declaration table carries the rows and design D8 records that "exactly" meant case and level, never a column

options_presented.label: A
options_presented.body: Widen the classifier to CommonMark's indentation and thematic-break rules and add the three rows' tests.

options_presented.label: B
options_presented.body: Keep the column-0/1 classifier and state its limit in the declaration requirement's table (headings and items read at indent 0-1 only; a thematic break reads MALFORMED).

retired: nested bullet under a well-formed item

introduced.text: a list item indented at most one space, or two or three spaces with no item above it in the current list
meant case and level, never a column

resolutions.title: The Split route does not say whether Step 0d's move and the PR choreography's Phase 3 still run
resolutions.action: applied the ratified direction A: after Split the rest of the flow runs unchanged — Step 0d's move, the PR choreography's Phase 3 and the completion emit — and only the closing chat line differs; the body says --strict keeps failing on the undeclared breach until the change is split; design D5 records why neither the move nor Phase 3 is skipped

options_presented.label: A
options_presented.body: Split continues the whole flow: the move runs, Phase 3 opens the draft PR, the emit is written; only the closing chat line changes.

options_presented.label: B
options_presented.body: Split runs the move and writes the emit but skips Phase 3 (no draft PR for a change being split), saying so in chat.

retired: the completion emit is still written

introduced.text: The rest of the flow runs unchanged
nothing else changes: the move, Phase 3 and the emit all run

resolutions.title: Declare says to re-run orbit validate --strict, but the propose body never runs it first
resolutions.action: named the validation before the brief as NON-STRICT `orbit validate <name>`, which size never fails, in the body's Position line, Step 0d's opener, the requirement and design D5; Declare now says "run" `orbit validate <name> --strict`

resolutions.title: Only the single-change human printer shows size issues on a valid report
resolutions.action: recorded the limit beside the requirement's human-printer sentence: the bulk run prints one line per item and no issue of any kind in human mode, and the deprecated `orbit change validate` prints no issue beneath a valid report, so a size issue there reaches --json and, under --strict, the item's failure line only; the bulk printers are not widened for one capability

introduced.text: prints one line per item and no issue of any kind in human mode
